fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/pete-creek-campground ('Single Site: $12 per night', page last updated May 1, 2026), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/pete-creek-campground ('$12.00 daily fee per single site 50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/pete-creek-campground ('The campground has 13 sites, including one host site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The FS narrative lists potable water, but the same page's amenity box says 'Potable water is not available at this site'; ask the Three Rivers RD before relying on water.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/pete-creek-campground ('Amenities include potable water, vault toilets'; 'Restrooms: Vault toilet(s)'; 'Water: Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Managed (staffed, fees) mid-May through mid-September; open to visitors all year, access weather-dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/pete-creek-campground ('The campground is managed from mid-May through mid-September, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF campground NW of Troy on Yaak Hwy 508, near the Yaak River. Gravel roads and parking spurs; one of the sites is the host's. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed $12/night, 13 sites incl. host, vault toilets, Senior/Access discount; added season year-round (managed mid-May - mid-Sept, open all year). Not stated on the current page: FCFS, the 24-ft trailer limit, hookups; left as they were. Potable water: the page contradicts itself, left as is. Forest Service, Three Rivers RD (406-295-4693). No alert for the campground or Hwy 508. Note trimmed of restated values.
